sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0006_wolfgd_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0006_wolfgd_* (fetched by 535e88f), as compiled by efsim kit-draft and corrected by hand where the data decides in IfElse branches: the battle skill's SpellInflict flag (frames 0-2, CheckTagMatch on the smart target: Burning -1110095722 = Combustion, Conduct 1466867135 = Electrification), the third shot's two projectiles at 23 and the additional shot's succeed / fail branches at landing. Frames are SkillData frames; every hit of a LaunchProjectile is at its launch frame (`launch`: the cast's own until then; travel isn't in the data, in-game test 47).

Timing from SkillData (loader): the battle skill's conditional JumpToAction 31 -> 118 (inside the IfElse on SpellInflict, D1; named by `jumps`), its unconditional 117 -> 247 and its MarkCanInterrupt at 48 (S1: a plain cast frees him at 48; the reaction path's jump skips the mark, so it holds until its exclusive frame 159 = real 72).

Values: SkillPatchTable chr_0006_wolfgd_*; talents (PotentialTalentEffectTable): talent 1 attaches buff_chr_0006_wolfgd_talent_0 (add 0.2 / 0.3, duration 10), talent 2 sets the battle skill's returnskillpower (5 / 10) and talent2. Potentials: P1 Strength +15 and Agility +15 (data); P2 potential_skillpower 10; P3 potential_3 and teammate_percent 0.5; P4 ultimate cost x0.85 (data); P5 potential_5 (the ultimate's combo reset).
Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0006_wolfgd.md (gap report, kit plan and the section "Kit"). No log fixture has Wulfgard: nothing here is verified by a log.

buffs.label: Thermite Tracers: the target had Combustion or Electrification at the cast
buffs.note: The battle skill's blackboard flag SpellInflict (ModifyDynamicBlackboard at frames 0-2 when the smart target carries the Burning or Conduct tag), which the frame-23 IfElse reads. State only; ends with the cast (10 s outlasts it).

buffs.label: Scorching Fangs: Heat DMG
buffs.note: Talent 1. buff_chr_0006_wolfgd_talent_0_effectbuff: attr 51 (Heat DMG) formulaItem 5 +add (0.2 / 0.3), duration 10 s, stackingType 4 max 1 (refreshed: "This effect cannot stack").

buffs.label: Scorching Fangs (P3, teammates): Heat DMG
buffs.note: P3: the battle skill at frame 141 (FindTarget CharacterTeamFinder, ModifyDynamicBlackboard teammate_percent x add, CreateBuff) gives the effect buff with add x teammate_percent (0.5). The finder has no validator, so the data's second CreateBuff reaches Wulfgard too; interim (report row 26): teammates only, as the description says ("grants other teammates Scorching Fangs with {teammate_percent} of the base effects"). Whether his own copy drops to 15% is in-game test 72.

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When an Arts Infliction is applied to an enemy." An infliction that forms a reaction at once doesn't count (the engine's inflictionApplied rule; in-game test 35, Wulfgard's part).

Talent 1: "Whenever Wulfgard applies Combustion, he gains Scorching Fangs." buff_chr_0006_wolfgd_talent_0 (lifeType 1): abilityEvent 102 (he applies a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext tag -1110095722 (Burning) -> the effect buff on him. The ultimate's forced Combustion counts (the engine's reaction event includes forced ones). Before the hit's damage: the data's SpellInfliction precedes its DamageAction (in-game test 51's question).
Frames 0-2: IfElse CheckTagMatch Burning / Conduct on the smart target -> SpellInflict = 1 (judged at the cast, as the jump at 31 is).

P3: "While Scorching Fangs is active, triggering the battle skill's additional effects immediately resets the Scorching Fangs duration and grants other teammates Scorching Fangs with {teammate_percent} of the base effects." At the additional shot's launch, skill frame 141 (IfElse potential_3 > 0 and CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced effect buff >= 1 on Wulfgard, judged when it runs). The cast's own delayed action: the 31 -> 118 jump moves it to real frame 54, the plain path's 117 -> 247 jump drops it, and so does a cut before it.

P5: "Casting the ultimate Wolven Fury immediately resets the cooldown of the combo skill." Ultimate frames 0-14: IfElse potential_5 > 0 -> SetSkillCdAtOnce functionType 1, skillTypeMask 64 (combo), value 0.

"forcibly applying Combustion": ChannelingAction frames 45-72 (every 0.2 s, maxCountPerTarget 1) -> buff_common_fire_fire_burning_triggered on target group target1 (forced Combustion, level I, 10 s). Interim 45, the compiler's frame (report row 35): the group is filled by the frame-46 FindTargetAction, so the first tick may find no one and the Combustion come at 51, after the first hit (then that hit has no Scorching Fangs: about 4% of the ultimate). Only a log settles it.

hits.note: LaunchProjectile at 7. ObtainCostAction atb x 0.5 for the controlled operator; atb is 0 at every level.

skills.label: Basic attack 2
skills.note: Two LaunchProjectiles (10, 16) of one projhit file: one hit entry each, so each is the cast's own until its launch.

hits.label: Final Strike
hits.note: Final Strike (mask 2097280, from the data). "As the controlled operator, Final Strike also deals {poise} Stagger": the poise unit is onlyEnableForMainChar; SP `atb` (18, natural: atbGainMethod 0) for the controlled operator.

skills.label: Dive attack
skills.note: Not castable until rotations have jumps (S10).

skills.label: Battle skill (Thermite Tracers)

hits.label: Final shot (the target had a reaction)
Final shot (Heat Infliction)
hits.note: "The final shot also applies Heat Infliction": the else branch, projhit_FireSpellInfiction (SpellInfliction Heat, then its DamageAction).

hits.label: Additional shot (consumes the reaction)
hits.note: "If the target has active Combustion or Electrification, consume the Arts Reaction to fire an additional shot that deals massive Heat DMG." Launched at 141 (the 31 -> 118 jump makes it real frame 54; the plain path's 117 -> 247 jump drops it). plus_projhit checks the target again at landing: with Burning / Conduct, talent 2's SP ("return {returnskillpower} SP", returned: atbGainMethod 1; P2 adds potential_skillpower inside talent2 > 0) and the DamageAction; after it, IfElse Burning -> FinishBuffByTag Burning, else Conduct -> FinishBuffByTag Conduct (afterDamage, A4: the shot keeps Electrification's Arts DMG Taken). The Electrification consumption comes first in the list, with the else as its `if`, because the second application's `if` is judged after the first ran.

hits.label: Additional shot (the reaction ran out meanwhile)
hits.note: plus_projhit's fail branch: SpellInfliction (Heat), DamageAction atk_scale_plus_fail; its poise key poise_extra_bullet_fail is 0 at every level (no stagger).

skills.note: LaunchProjectile at 6 and 16 (normal_skill_projhit), at 23 (projhit_1 or projhit_FireSpellInfiction by SpellInflict) and at 141 (plus_projhit); team energy at 23 (buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp, ratio 1). The P3 effects at 141 are the trigger hunting_hour.

hits.note: LaunchProjectile at 12 -> combo_skill_projhit -> SpawnAbilityEntity abilityentity_chr_0006_wolfgd_combo_skill -> combo_skill_abilityrange at entity frame 0: SpellInfliction (Heat), DamageAction atk_scale + poise, ObtainCostAction costType 0 usp. Travel unknown (Zero Sanity's 0.9 s would be about 15 frames later).
"dealing 5 hits of Heat DMG": DamageActions in the skill at 46, 52, 59, 64, 69 (mask 4608). The six wolf projectiles at 45-65 cast nothing (every castSkillOn... flag false).
